title: ixora neglecta
intro: Ixora neglecta, commonly known as the wild pink ixora, is a flowering plant species native to tropical Asia. The wild pink ixora has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and fever, due to its health benefits of reducing oxidative stress and improving antioxidant activity. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ixora neglecta also include kaempferol, quercetin, and isorhapontigenin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
